In the second installment of a three-part series, guest authors Mark Himmelsbach and Remy Pinson write that while founders are being forced to adapt to rapidly increasing AI leverage, traditional roles — even leadership — risk being redefined or replaced. The real challenge, they write, is cultural: rebuilding trust, identity, motivation and belonging in organizations where humans and AI now share the work.
